source: Dallas City Code ch. 51P, Article 109 (City Attorney's codified article, April 2026)

sections.title: Legislative History
sections.text: SEC. 51P-109.101.LEGISLATIVE HISTORY. PD 109 was established by Ordinance No. 16132, passed by the Dallas City Council on February 21, 1979. Ordinance No. 16132 amended Ordinance No. 10962, Chapter 51 of the Dallas City Code, as amended. (Ord. Nos. 10962; 16132; 25508)

sections.title: Property Location And Size
sections.text: SEC. 51P-109.102.PROPERTY LOCATION AND SIZE. PD 109 is established on property generally fronting on the north line of Forest Lane, beginning at a point approximately 2038.9 feet east of the east line of Preston Road. The size of PD 109 is approximately 5.3593 acres. (Ord. Nos. 16132; 25508)

sections.title: Definitions And Interpretations
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-109.103.DEFINITIONS AND INTERPRETATIONS.
(a)Unless otherwise stated, the definitions and interpretations in Chapter 51 apply to this article.
(b)Unless otherwise stated, all references to articles, divisions, or sections in this article are to articles, divisions, or sections in Chapter 51. (Ord. 25508)

sections.title: Development Plan
sections.text: SEC. 51P-109.104.DEVELOPMENT PLAN. All development must be in accordance with the city plan commission-approved development plan (Exhibit 109A). (Ord. Nos. 16132; 25508)

sections.title: Uses
sections.text: SEC. 51P-109.105.USES. Single-family units, attached or detached, and common open areas are permitted. (Ord. Nos. 16132; 25508)

sections.title: Subdivision Plat
sections.text: SEC. 51P-109.106.SUBDIVISION PLAT. Development of this PD must be in accordance with the subdivision plat that has been approved and filed for record. (Ord. Nos. 16132; 25508)

sections.title: Density
sections.text: SEC. 51P-109.107.DENSITY. A maximum of 23 dwelling units is permitted. (Ord. Nos. 16132; 25508)

sections.title: Streets And Paving
sections.text: SEC. 51P-109.108.STREETS AND PAVING. All driveways, entrances, and dedicated streets must be constructed to the requirements of the department of public works and transportation and other departments of the city. (Ord. Nos. 16132; 25508; 26102)

sections.title: Homeowners’ Association
sections.text: SEC. 51P-109.109.HOMEOWNERS’ ASSOCIATION. A homeowners’ association must be created by the developer for the purpose of proper care and maintenance of the common areas and any other function deemed appropriate. The instrument creating the homeowners’ association must be approved by the city attorney as to legal form and by the city plan commission as to the suitability for the proposed use, and filed in the Deed Records of Dallas County, Texas, before the release of the final plat for the development. (Ord. Nos. 16132; 25508)

sections.title: Signs
sections.text: SEC. 51P-109.110.SIGNS. All signs must comply with the provisions for non-business zoning districts as specified in Chapter 41, “Sign Standards,” of the Dallas City Code. (Ord. Nos. 16132; 25508)

sections.title: Setbacks
sections.text: SEC. 51P-109.111.SETBACKS. All buildings must be set back as indicated on the development plan. (Ord. Nos. 16132; 25508)

sections.title: Height
sections.text: SEC. 51P-109.112.HEIGHT. No residential structure may exceed 24 feet in height. (Ord. Nos. 16132; 25508)

sections.title: Coverage
sections.text: SEC. 51P-109.113.COVERAGE. Maximum percent of lot area which may be covered by the main building and all accessory buildings for residential uses may not exceed 60 percent. (Ord. Nos. 16132; 25508)

sections.title: Parking
sections.text: SEC. 51P-109.114.PARKING. Parking must be provided at the ratio of three spaces per residential unit, and the required spaces may be placed in tandem. In no instance may a parking space violate a platted building line. All enclosed parking spaces located so as to face upon or be entered directly from a street or alley may be located not nearer than 20 feet from the property line. (Ord. Nos. 16132; 25508)

sections.title: General Requirements
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-109.115.GENERAL REQUIREMENTS.
(a)Development of the Property must comply with the requirements of all departments of the city.
(b)All paved areas, permanent drives, streets, and drainage structures, if any, must be constructed in accordance with standard city specifications, and completed to the satisfaction of the director of public works and transportation.
(c)The building official shall not issue a certificate of occupancy until there has been full compliance with this article and any of the city applicable provisions of the Comprehensive General Zoning Ordinance of the city and the Dallas Building Code. (Ord. Nos. 16132; 25508; 26102)

sections.title: Zoning Map
sections.text: SEC. 51P-109.116.ZONING MAP. PD 109 is located on Zoning Map No. D-7. (Ord. 25508)
